disposition: Three pre-commit lifecycle hooks exist with a cannot-partially-commit contract — before-store (value mutation plus veto), before-delete (veto), after-save (operation and sequence observation) — focused-tested. Gap: only these three of V1's hook points exist; there are no query, request success/failure, topology-update, or session-disposing hooks, and conversion hooks are a recorded accepted difference (typed documents, SDK-side mapping per GAP-D01) rather than implemented behavior.
